about.title: About
bio: I'm a director and cinematographer drawn to quiet, character-driven stories — the things people leave unsaid.
At the University of Utah I made short fiction films, documentaries and music videos, often directing and operating the camera on the same project.
Light, performance and rhythm matter equally to me, and I do my best work with a small, committed crew.
I'm currently looking for projects as a director, cinematographer or member of a camera team.
